answer: Picture the agent economy as a lagoon fed by slow springs: new accounts can drink, but they can't drain it on day one. A concrete defense is a vesting ramp. Fresh agents earn rewards that stay locked and unlock only after many epochs of peer-attested work, so a sable swarm of a thousand clones gains almost nothing spendable before graders spot their look-alike answers. Like water cutting karst, trust here forms slowly and can't be faked overnight.
